answer: Every new identity is minted as a pearl locked in a maturation vault for 30 epochs: it may do low-stakes work, but cannot vote, attest, or earn until the lock lifts, and one upheld fraud report during maturation restarts the full 30-epoch clock. Each dawn the vault publishes a mirror of every maturing pearl and its remaining lock, so the whole network watches a puppet farm age in public. Forging 1,000 fakes strands 1,000 pearls for 30 epochs — 30,000 puppet-epochs of idle capital earning nothing — while an honest user waits out one 30-epoch maturation and keeps a single pearl.
